intro: Sudan's economy, based on farming, gold and livestock, has been shattered by war.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Sudan is a leading producer of gum arabic, used in soft drinks and sweets. Gold mining, livestock and cotton matter too. Most oil was lost when South Sudan became independent.

chapters.title: Farming
text: The Gezira scheme between the two Niles is one of the largest irrigation projects in the world.

keyTerms.meaning: A tree sap used in food and medicine.

cardGroups.title: Made in Sudan
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Sudan makes and sells to the world.
